name: Brainworm Befriend
storyline:
We've all had a brainworm or two in our lifetime. Perhaps you've heard them as a voice in your head, or maybe felt them as they seemingly pulled your mind in different directions like multi-dimensional tug-o-war. So what's an ambiguously gendered protagonist to do? Introducing the Internal World Connector! With this nifty device, not only can you track your health data and receive reminders in real time, but also meet and befriend your very own "parts"!*

Let's see how it goes for our little test subject here, shall we?
summary:
A visual novel about befriending pieces of yourself.

This game is based on a psychological framework called Internal Family Systems, which sees the mind as being composed of multiple sub-personalities or "parts", and it being possible to directly talk to them and befriend them.
